The second and third paths connect Cassiamin A to L-lactate dehydrogenase C chain, which is targeted by (4E,8E,11R)-5,9-dimethyl-12-oxabicyclo[9.2.1]tetradeca-1(14),4,8-trien-13-one, a compound that also targets Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. These pathways suggest that Cassiamin A may influence the activity of various enzymes or compounds that ultimately modulate the function of the Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The shared target indicates a potential mechanism where Cassiamin A could act as a modulator or regulator of the transporter, possibly through the activation or inhibition of downstream targets. The evidence supports a role for Cassiamin A in the regulation of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3, though the exact mechanism remains to be elucidated.
